- The segment note records that to carry out lodging, restaurant and banquet services 'the company has acquired an Hotel at Gujarat on rental basis'. The profit engine of the year therefore sits on a rental arrangement rather than an owned asset, exposing the Company to renewal, rent-escalation and single-property risk.
